deciding_facts: Peer median operating margin rose 519 bps (5.96% to 11.16%) over FY2020 to FY2022 while STRA fell 1,202 bps (20.31% to 8.29%): attribution ratio -0.43, and STRA went from +1,435 bps above the peer median to -286 bps below it.

Margin fell on rising revenue over the window (+2.55%, FY2020 to FY2022); the pandemic hit was specific to Strayer's campus and working-adult model (CEO: 'a multi-year decline in enrollment at Strayer'), not an industry-wide margin cycle.
confidence_note: Peer set is small and mixed fiscal years; LRN, UTI and CVSA grew through the pandemic via K-12 online, trades and the Walden acquisition, so the peer median flatters the comparison. LOPE, the closest adult online peer, fell 638 bps. Management has since hit the 2023 notional model, which argues the recovery is real even if the decline was company-specific.
